newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide upgrades web site.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide upgrades web site.

text.p: Emery Worldwide has upgraded its Internet web site with more user-friendly features. Their site, (http://www.emeryworld.com), has been redesigned for multi-modal tracking and tracing. In addition it will serve as an on-line Customer Resource Centre, the company said.
Douglas J. Foster, Emery's vice president of sales and marketing said that in response to the year-long experience with the original site, the redesigned site will be even more user friendly.

"There has been a dramatic increase in the number of customer using Emery's air freight tracking feature as well as numerous requests to track all types of shipments, regardless of transportation mode," Foster said.

The status of air and ocean shipments as well an those involving customs clearances handled by Emery's brokerage unit will now be accessible. Ocean tracking will become available in April, while air and customs brokerage tracking is currently activated.
Emery's new web page search engine and site map will help users locate specific information easily by typing in a keyword or entering the search area and clicking on a topic in hypertext.
Emery Worldwide is a subsidiary of CNF Transportation Inc., based in Paolo Alto, California. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
